topic: Hollywood actors box office earnings over time

interpretations.label: Total Domestic Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: The cumulative box office revenue generated by films starring the actor within the United States and Canada.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Sum of unadjusted U.S. box office ticket sales gross in USD ($)
caveats: Does not account for ticket price inflation over time
Leaning heavily on ensemble casts can disproportionately inflate an actor's total

interpretations.label: Total Worldwide Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: The cumulative box office revenue generated globally by films starring the actor across all international markets.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Sum of worldwide box office ticket sales gross in USD ($)
caveats: International box office tracking was less consistent or available in early historical periods
Does not adjust for currency fluctuations or inflation

interpretations.label: Inflation-Adjusted Domestic Box Office Gross
interpretations.description: The cumulative box office revenue generated by films starring the actor adjusted for historical ticket price inflation.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Sum of U.S. box office gross adjusted to current year dollars using official ticket price index in USD ($)
caveats: Complex to calculate accurately for films released decades ago
Dependent on accurate historical attendance estimates

preferredSources: Industry trade publications (Variety, The Hollywood Reporter)
knownRisks: Lack of reliable global box office data prior to the mid-20th century
Ambiguity between starring roles versus minor cameos or voice-only roles
Distortion caused by massive blockbuster franchises featuring ensemble casts
